arxiv-1912-02444.title: Robustness of Low-Complexity Massive MIMO Architectures Against Passive Eavesdropping
arxiv-1912-02444.creator: Ali Bereyhi, Student Member, IEEE , Saba Asaad, Student Member, IEEE , Ralf R. Müller, Senior Member, IEEE , Rafael F. Schaefer, Senior Member, IEEE , Georg Fischer, Senior Member, IEEE , and H. Vincent Poor, Fellow, IEEE
arxiv-1912-02444.description: Abstract Invoking large transmit antenna arrays, massive MIMO wiretap settings are capable of suppressing passive eavesdroppers via narrow beamforming towards legitimate terminals. This implies that secrecy is obtained almost for free in these settings. We show that this property holds not only for fully digital MIMO architectures, but also in massive MIMO settings whose transmitters employ architectures with reduced complexity.

arxiv-2111-10038.title: From word-representable graphs to altered Tverberg-type theorems
arxiv-2111-10038.creator: D. Oliveros, A.J. Torres
arxiv-2111-10038.description: Abstract Tverberg’s theorem says that a set with sufficiently many points in ℝ d \mathbb{R}^{d} can always be partitioned into m m parts so that the ( m − 1 ) (m-1) -simplex is the (nerve) intersection pattern of the convex hulls of the parts.

arxiv-2111-11266.title: Modular structure of the Weyl algebra
arxiv-2111-11266.creator: Roberto Longo
arxiv-2111-11266.description: Abstract We study the modular Hamiltonian associated with a Gaussian state on the Weyl algebra. We obtain necessary/sufficient criteria for the local equivalence of Gaussian states, independently of the classical results by Araki and Yamagami, Van Daele, Holevo. We then present a criterion for a Bogoliubov automorphism to be weakly inner in the GNS representation.

arxiv-2401-11659.title: Dynamical invariant based shortcut to equilibration in open quantum systems
arxiv-2401-11659.creator: Mohamed Boubakour, Shimpei Endo, Thomás Fogarty, Thomas Busch
arxiv-2401-11659.description: Abstract We propose using the dynamical invariants, also known as the Lewis–Riesenfeld invariants, to speed-up the equilibration of a driven open quantum system. This allows us to reverse engineer the time-dependent master equation that describes the dynamics of the open quantum system and systematically derive a protocol that realizes a shortcut to equilibration.

arxiv-2404-01790.title: Super-Resolution Analysis for Landfill Waste Classification
arxiv-2404-01790.creator: Matías Molina, Rita P. Ribeiro, Bruno Veloso, João Gama
arxiv-2404-01790.description: Abstract Illegal landfills are a critical issue due to their environmental, economic, and public health impacts. This study leverages aerial imagery for environmental crime monitoring. While advances in artificial intelligence and computer vision hold promise, the challenge lies in training models with high-resolution literature datasets and adapting them to open-access low-resolution images.

arxiv-2501-03019.title: An Independent Search for Small Long-period Planets in Kepler data I: Detection Pipeline
arxiv-2501-03019.creator: Oryna Ivashtenko, Barak Zackay
arxiv-2501-03019.description: Abstract The unprecedented photometric precision of Kepler mission allows searching for Earth-like planets. However, it remains difficult to distinguish these low signal-to-noise planets from the false alarms originating from correlated and non-Gaussian noise. It reduces the resulting planetary catalog reliability and makes it hard to measure the occurrence rate of small long-period planets.

arxiv-2604-18439.title: Classical counterparts of shortcuts to adiabaticity in nonlinear dissipative Lagrangian systems
arxiv-2604-18439.creator: Jincheng Shi, Yicheng Pan, Yue Ban, Xi Chen

arxiv-2605-03661.creator: Yuxuan Yang

arxiv-2605-26732.creator: Yifan Sun, Lei Cheng, Sijie Chen, Ting Zhang, Jianlong Li, Shikai Fang

pmc-10587034.title: Racial and Ethnic Disparities in the Management of Diabetic Feet
pmc-10587034.creator: Elizabeth O Clayton, Confidence Njoku-Austin, Devon M Scott, Jarrett D Cain, MaCalus V Hogan
pmc-10587034.description: Purpose of ReviewDiabetes mellitus is a chronic medical condition affecting many individuals worldwide and leads to billions of dollars spent within the healthcare system for its treatment and complications. Complications from diabetes include diabetic foot conditions that can have a devasting impact on quality of life.

pmc-11425090.title: Circular economy innovations: Balancing fossil fuel impact on green economic development
pmc-11425090.creator: Yiwen Zhang
pmc-11425090.description: The transition to a green economy is essential for sustainable development, yet the reliance on fossil fuels poses a significant challenge. This study investigates the impact of fossil fuel consumption on green economic development and examines circular economy innovations as a potential solution.

pmc-11646006.title: P084 General practitioner training on obstructive sleep apnoea and long-term care: a pilot study
pmc-11646006.creator: S Abbas, S Liaw, G Marks, P Buchanan, J Williamson, A Johnson, M Tam, F Garden, Y Chung, H Vedam
pmc-11646006.description: General practitioner training on obstructive sleep apnoea and long-term care: a pilot studyIntroductionObstructive sleep apnoea (OSA) can be treated using continuous positive airway pressure (CPAP) therapy; however, many patients experience difficulties acclimatising and persisting with this treatment. In view of the increasing prevalence of OSA, evidence-based models of care not limited to sleep physicians are urgently required.

pmc-12445482.title: Contrasting and prioritizing dimensions in ethnic teacher education: A convergent analysis with LDA and fsQCA
pmc-12445482.creator: Qimeng Wu, Qiyun Wu, Muhammad Zammad Aslam, Muhammad Zammad Aslam, Muhammad Zammad Aslam
pmc-12445482.description: Previous studies have rarely examined ethnic teacher education from a configurational perspective. This study addresses that gap.This study analyzes 250 peer-reviewed articles from CNKI’s PKU/CSSCI journals (2015–2025), identified using ‘ethnic teacher education/education/teachers’ keywords, refined from 2,672 initial records through manual screening.This study employs a mixed-methods approach to investigate ethnic teacher education in China, combining computational text analysis with configurational methods.

pmc-12539095.title: Reduced aerobic capacity in children with multisystem inflammatory syndrome in children (MIS-C) after PICU admission: a retrospective cohort study, 2020–2022
pmc-12539095.creator: Albane BR Maggio, Sofia Palomo, Raphael Joye, Héléna Huguet, Angelo Polito, Arthur Gavotto
pmc-12539095.description: ObjectiveThis study aimed to evaluate aerobic capacity in children and adolescents following a diagnosis of Multisystem Inflammatory Syndrome in Children (MIS-C) compared to healthy matched controls. DesignProspective cohort study.SettingQuaternary Pediatric intensive care unit and Pediatric cardiology unit.Participants14 children diagnosed with MIS-C.InterventionsNone.MeasurementsCardiopulmonary fitness parameters at the time of post-Pediatric intensive care unit follow-up (mean 3.

pmc-12661518.title: The role of biological nitrogen fixation in polyhydroxybutyrate production from methane by methane-oxidizing bacteria: a review of metabolic routes and yield enhancement
pmc-12661518.creator: Jin Hui Xie, Jia Ying Xin, Li Rui Sun, Tian Yu Cui, Hai Xin Bi, Yan Wang, Jian Xiong Zhang
pmc-12661518.description: In recent years, the synthesis of Polyhydroxybutyrate (PHB) using methane-oxidizing bacteria (MOB) to convert one carbon and N2 resources has received much attention. In addition, nitrogen fixation by nitrogen gas (N2) has an effect on the metabolic pathways of MOB.

pmc-12720451.title: Assessment of limited cardiac ultrasound to screen for mitral regurgitation
pmc-12720451.creator: Divya Velury, Benjamin Koethe, Monica M Dehn, Eileen Mai, Dikran R Balian, Brian C Downey, Arsalan Rafiq, Ayan R Patel, Benjamin S Wessler
pmc-12720451.description: BackgroundMitral regurgitation (MR) is under-diagnosed and under-treated. Point-of-care ultrasound devices now include color Doppler technologies that can enhance the physical exam. Focused handheld imaging protocols might improve detection of mitral regurgitation.MethodsPatients were prospectively scanned with a limited protocol using the Butterfly IQ + device at Tufts Medical Center (Boston, MA).

pmc-12996193.title: Urethral diverticulum complicated by multiple calculi secondary to urethral mesh erosion: A case report
pmc-12996193.creator: Maria Papastamatiou, Iakovos Theodoulidis, Pantelis Trompoukis, Sofia Papaioannou, Grigoris F. Grimbizis, Themistoklis Mikos
pmc-12996193.description: The case of a 65-year-old woman with a complication 15 years after mesh repair of vaginal prolapse is presented. The patient presented with chronic pelvic pain, recurrent urinary tract infections (UTIs), foul-smelling vaginal discharge, and urinary frequency/urgency for the previous eight years.

pmc-13084398.title: Generalizable Direct Protein Sequencing With InstaNexus
pmc-13084398.creator: Marco Reverenna, Maike Wennekers Nielsen, Darian Stephan Wolff, Jemma Daniel, Elpida Lytra, Suthimon Thumtecho, Pasquale D Colaianni, Anne Ljungars, Andreas H Laustsen, Erwin M Schoof, Jeroen Van Goey, Timothy P Jenkins, Marie V Lukassen, Alberto Santos, Konstantinos Kalogeropoulos
pmc-13084398.description: Accurate determination of protein sequences is central to biology. Protein-based therapeutics, such as antibodies and nanobodies, are not encoded in reference genomes, challenging their accurate characterization via standard proteomics. Current methods rely on indirect inference, fragmented outputs, and labor-intensive workflows, which hinder functional insights and routine application.

pmc-13142045.title: The role of universities in society
pmc-13142045.creator: Michèle Belot, Lea Cassar, Karoline Ströhlein
pmc-13142045.description: This study examines public views on universities’ societal roles beyond education and research. A representative sample of 2089 U.S. citizens evaluates whether universities should engage in initiatives such as diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI), free speech, and environmental sustainability, benchmarking views against corporations.

pmc-13272003.title: Insulinoma in pregnancy: a case report and literature review of diagnostic challenges, multidisciplinary management, and therapeutic dilemmas
pmc-13272003.creator: Abdullah Faiz Zaihan, Shairyzah Ahmad Hisham, Srinivas Siwalinggam, Noor Hayatul Al Akmal Noralam, Kaeshaelya Thiruchelvam, Chia Siang Kow
pmc-13272003.description: BackgroundInsulinoma during pregnancy is exceedingly rare, with fewer than 30 cases reported worldwide. Diagnosis is often delayed due to overlapping physiological and gestational symptoms, posing significant risks to both mother and fetus.CaseWe report a case of a 36-year-old gravida 4 para 2 + 1 woman presenting at 7 weeks’ gestation with recurrent symptomatic hypoglycaemia.

pmc-13372075.title: Research on the Improvement Path of Human-AI Collaborative Consultation Effectiveness From the Perspective of Information Ecology: Configurational Analysis
pmc-13372075.creator: Dandan Wang, Mengyi Zhang, Bingjun Guo, Arriel Benis
pmc-13372075.description: BackgroundEnhancing the effectiveness of human-AI collaborative consultation in online health communities (OHCs) constitutes a core requirement for optimizing the allocation of medical resources and promoting the sustainable development of medical services. Nevertheless, the pathways to improving such effectiveness remain insufficiently understood.

pmc-13449843.title: Endothelin-1 Signaling Mediates Hypoxia-Induced Microglial Activation Through Reactive Oxygen Species and Mitogen-Activated Protein Kinase Pathways
pmc-13449843.creator: Yandy Garcia, Ricardo Vázquez, Yalimar P Pomales-Inostroza, Sebastian Castaño, Francisco Rodriguez, Blake Bailey, Yaritza Inostroza-Nieves
pmc-13449843.description: Oxidative stress and neuroinflammation are critical contributors to hypoxic-ischemic brain injury. Microglia, the CNS-resident immune cells, undergo rapid activation in response to hypoxic stress. Endothelin-1 (ET-1), a vasoconstrictor implicated in cerebrovascular pathology, is upregulated by hypoxia; however, its role in microglial activation remains poorly understood. HMC3 human microglial cells were exposed to hypoxia (1% O2) for 4 hours.

pmc-13532231.title: High prevalence of HTLV-1 among blood donors in southeastern Gabon (Central Africa): a major challenge for transfusion safety in a semi-rural area
pmc-13532231.creator: Hanneke Moussonda-Mouélé, Jill-Léa Ramassamy, Eldridge Fedricksen Oloumbou, Antony Idam Mamimandjiami, Noémie Delolme, Christ Eddy Ognari-Ayoumi, Moussa Yaro, Tiburce Etele, Ivan Sosthène Mfouo-Tynga, Olivier Cassar, Antoine Gessain, Augustin Mouinga-Ondémé
pmc-13532231.description: Sub-Saharan Africa is an endemic region for human T-lymphotropic virus type 1 (HTLV-1). While high prevalence rates have been reported across Gabon, systematic screening of blood donors has not yet been implemented at the national level. A cross-sectional study was conducted on 2,375 blood donations from 2,303 blood donors at the Amissa Bongo Teaching Hospital Center in Franceville.
